title: Sherlock + Academy
titleNative: シャーロック＋アカデミー
synopsis: The need for detectives has dramatically increased in response to the increasing number of violent crimes. This year, a boy and a girl enter Marimine Detective Academy, an ultra-exclusive school, and the only one in Japan that offers the "National Detective License." The boy is Misaki Fujisaki, the grandson of the man who was once known as the "Crime King." The girl is Shia E. Hazeldine, the adopted daughter of the man known as the "Detective King." These two descendants of sworn enemies will meet each other by chance! And as their school days begin, an incident occurs right from the entrance ceremony!? Moreover, for some reason, Fujisaki's score is higher than Shia's, even though she supposedly solved the mystery first... "I challenge you!" "Don't regret this, princess." This is a unique academy story where students compete to find the truth. This is intellectual excitement at its highest peak! (Source: MFBunko J, translated)

title: Monochrome Lovers
synopsis: One day, suddenly, an angel came descending from the sky?! While heading towards his university entrance ceremony, Inchinose Yuu meets an unsociable, mysterious girl, Nanase Yuu. Yuu, who can't help but be curious of her — who is as free-willing as a stray cat — gradually shortens the distance between them. As various feelings mix around, their bond gets spun together, but what can be seen beyond that is…

synopsis: A boy-meets-girl story about Mita, a tough-looking but clumsy high school girl, and Hitoyoshi, a timid high school boy. Hitoyoshi, who is extremely afraid of everything, is suddenly approached by the tough-looking Mita on the train in the morning. It seems she got sick on the train. Hitoyoshi, though scared, takes care of her and catches a glimpse of Mita's clumsy and awkward side, which he never would have imagined from her appearance... (Source: Natalie, translated)

title: Osu! Karate Club
synopsis: Matsushita Tadashi is a second year student at Kangokou High School (in Osaka, Japan) and a constant target of Kangokou's numerous bullies who beat him up routinely after school. He is accompanied by his best friend Saitou Takaki, who is also constantly harassed. As the pair grow increasingly tired of being victimized they decide to join the titular Karate Club, which is notorious throughout Osaka's youth gangs for training and producing the city's most hardened and toughest teenage thugs while maintaining the facade of a legit school sports club. But when they join the club, they find themselves picked on just as much if not worse by the club's current members.
